description.value:
Duration constant

You are never without viable seed. You are always considered to have any material component a Seed-Warden spell requires, in any conditions — underwater, in ash, in a sealed room, on stone. In addition, you may cast Rootwake targeting a square you cannot draw a line of effect to, provided you know where it is and it is within the spell's usual range. You still cannot target a square that does not exist or that is fully enclosed in solid worked stone.
